tagline: Find real vulnerabilities. Earn your first bounty.
description: A 12-week guided path from zero to your first valid bug report. Built for beginners who want practical results, not endless theory.
outcome: A portfolio, a methodology, and your first HackerOne report.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Foundations
phases.subtitle: Weeks 1–4 · Build the base every hacker needs

items.title: Networking Basics
items.detail: Understand IP, HTTP, DNS, and how data moves across the web.

items.title: Linux Command Line
items.detail: Navigate, edit files, and run tools from the terminal with confidence.

items.title: How the Web Works
items.detail: Requests, responses, cookies, sessions — the language of web security.

items.title: Mini Project: Port Scanner
items.detail: Build a simple Python script that scans open ports on a target.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Core Web Security
phases.subtitle: Weeks 5–8 · Learn how bugs actually work

items.title: OWASP Top 10
items.detail: SQLi, XSS, IDOR, SSRF — the vulnerabilities that pay bounties.

items.title: Burp Suite Mastery
items.detail: Intercept, modify, and replay requests like a professional tester.

items.title: HTTP Deep Dive
items.detail: Use browser DevTools daily to inspect headers, cookies, and tokens.

items.title: Mini Project: Vulnerability Report
items.detail: Write a professional report on one lab you solved — like a real bug bounty submission.

items.title: Recon Fundamentals
items.detail: Subdomain discovery, live host detection, and directory fuzzing.

items.title: Study Real Reports
items.detail: Read 5 beginner-friendly HackerOne disclosures to learn patterns.

items.title: First Live Target
items.detail: Pick one VDP with wide scope and start testing — legally and ethically.

items.title: Document Everything
items.detail: Even duplicates teach you. Keep a hunting journal from day one.
